name: Sign a score file with the wrong key (hal_v2 seal)
tool: python hal_v2.py seal --seal-id saboteur-test --subject-event-hash ea870798380cce44d84a81e110cf2d51662154f867abb66436a2636b812c66d0 --decision allow --tier-req 3 --authoriser-score-file leighton/example/validator-01.score.json --output saboteur-seal.json
